text:
reza: quick postmortem from this morning's EMEA CSV push  ~18 leads to overflow even though SDR queues were clear. pattern looks like handshake jitter + enrichment latency.

mia: saw the same. enrichment latency spiked to 35-50s for bulk imports; claim_ttl is 25s so TTL wins and fallback triggers.

oliver: idea: add a per-route import_grace_mode that keeps a 'pending_reassign' state for X ms after claim expiry. if enrichment returns owner within that window we auto-reassign if safety checks pass.

reza: love per-route opt-in. safety checks: enrichment.confidence >= 0.6, enrichment.source in ["hubspot_bulk","hs_csv_v2"], and SF.last_activity < enrichment.timestamp. also add per-rep reassign rate limit 3/hr.

mia: operational plan for canary:
- enable import_grace_mode on CSV-import route for 2% of traffic
- set grace_window_ms = 40000
- instrument metrics: import_deferred_candidates, import_reassign_success, import_overflow_rate
- alert if reassign_failure_rate > 5% or overflow_rate unchanged after 6h

oliver: adding logs: event types claim_acquire, claim_expire, deferred_candidate, reassign_attempt, reassign_outcome. include enrichment_source/version in the envelope.

support-bot: note: support rota notified. reminder to mute noisy alerts during canary window.

reza: runbook snippet for support: when rep reports missing lead -> check claim lifecycle, enrichment latency and source, deferred_candidate logs, SF last_activity, manual reassign steps.

mia: i'll own dashboard and alerts. oliver pls draft PR with toggle and rate-limit. keep default off.

oliver: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/lead-routing/pull/944 (WIP). will include rollback toggle and migration.

reza: start canary at 01:30 UTC for 6h. report back with metrics snapshot at 3h and 6h. :thumbsup:
